# Cordis Core API

Detailed API documentation derived from the Cordis source. The compact
cross-package index remains available in [`../api.md`](../api.md).

| Area | English | 中文 |
|---|---|---|
| Context and service lookup | [Context](context.md) | [上下文](context.zh.md) |
| Event dispatch | [Events](events.md) | [事件](events.zh.md) |
| Plugin lifecycle and effects | [Fiber](fiber.md) | [Fiber](fiber.zh.md) |
| Plugin loading and injection | [Registry](registry.md) | [注册表](registry.zh.md) |
| Service base class | [Service](service.md) | [Service](service.zh.md) |

The [inherited API summary](inherited.md) covers the context members and
events contributed by core and the loader, HMR, and timer plugins.
